issue.title: just test-scoped fails 49 nodes on clean master 4858f20a2; 26 have no bead (keymap help, completion snapshots, prompt panel, monitor stop)
issue.description:
The escalated `just test-scoped` lane run by `just check` fails 49 tests on clean master 4858f20a2 (47,096 passed). I reproduced the identical 49 failures a second time on a pristine tree (working tree stashed) with a targeted rerun, so none is caused by the change that surfaced them. Load average on the host was about 36 during the first run, but the second run was targeted and failed the same set.

Already tracked elsewhere (corroborated with +1 on the existing beads, not part of this task): sase-13p (test_app_import_budget, 3355 modules vs the 3290 cap), sase-18k (test_ctrl_e_moves_to_line_end_while_completion_remains_open), sase-184 (three test_agent_prompt_panel_monitor.py nodes), sase-175 (test_same_body_in_different_projects_does_not_coalesce), sase-174 (test_no_ref_prefix_dispatch). The 16 nodes that still expect the retired `family=` spelling were recorded as a DISCOVERED ISSUE on epic sase-17m, whose phase 17m.4 owns them.

The remaining 26 nodes have no bead that I could find and their root causes are not yet diagnosed, so triage should split them by cause:

- Keymap and help text: tests/test_keymaps_defaults_modes.py::test_zoom_and_agents_fold_defaults_are_in_sync_with_help; tests/test_keymaps_display_help_agents.py::test_agents_help_describes_zoom_and_isolation_and_capital_h_collapsing and ::test_all_tab_help_guides_show_forward_jump_and_agents_metadata_sections; tests/ace/tui/modals/test_help_modal.py::test_help_modal_refresh_for_tab_rebuilds_sections
- Zoom, fold and panels: tests/ace/tui/test_agent_fold_transitions_llm_calls.py::test_llm_calls_panel_h_navigates_while_capital_h_compacts_detail and ::test_llm_calls_panel_detail_clamp_does_not_fall_through_to_folds; tests/test_file_panel.py::test_zoom_file_cap_subtitle_points_to_editor
- Completion: tests/completion/test_snapshot.py::test_checked_in_snapshot_has_no_drift and ::test_current_structural_view_matches_checked_in_snapshot (sase-pr previously saw these as parallel-lane flakes; here they also fail alone); tests/completion/test_kind_coverage.py::test_every_value_slot_is_kinded_choiced_or_hinted; tests/ace/tui/test_model_completion_panel_titles.py::test_equals_alias_shortcut_subtitle_prioritizes_expansion_preview and ::test_provider_completion_row_subtitle_explains_drill_down
- Agent prompt panel: tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_prompt_semantic.py (3 nodes: test_agent_xprompt_and_prompt_receive_roles_replies_do_not, test_hint_mode_restores_file_hints_after_semantics, test_family_pinned_and_workflow_authored_prompt_paths); tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_prompt_panel_xprompts.py::test_update_display_renders_xprompts_after_detail_settles; tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_prompt_panel_steps.py::test_parallel_step_does_not_show_agent_prompt; tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_jump_panel_visibility.py::test_search_overlay_keeps_jump_panel_visible
- Monitor stop: tests/test_agent_monitor_stop_action.py::test_stop_monitor_submission_includes_artifacts_context and ::test_confirming_stop_submits_background_task
- Other: tests/test_timezone_display_tui.py::test_llm_calls_panel_fallbacks_use_configured_wall_time; tests/test_llm_provider_effort_invocation.py::test_codex_appends_reasoning_effort_config; tests/test_agent_group_revival_e2e.py::test_agents_command_palette_exposes_save_marked_group; tests/test_agent_artifact_dismissed_save_audit.py::test_dismissed_agent_save_sites_are_reviewed; tests/ace/tui/test_visual_fixture_host_paths.py::test_visual_fixtures_embed_no_host_home_paths; tests/ace/tui/test_agents_tab_current_project_seed.py::test_update_state_rebuilds_when_seeded_flag_changes

Reproduce with `.venv/bin/python -m pytest <node ids> -q -n 0`; all fail on 4858f20a2. Note that `just check` currently stops at a separate mypy failure in tools/ (see the wheel-cache bead), so run `just test-scoped` directly.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The same 49 nodes failed in the escalated just test-scoped run and again in a separate targeted rerun on a pristine tree with local changes stashed; they fail alone with -n 0, so this is not a parallel-lane ordering flake.

payload.description: One node of the 49 failures is tracked there (test_app_import_budget); corroborated rather than duplicated

evidence.note: Independent repro by sase-18g.land (2026-09-24): a serial pytest rerun of the lastfailed non-visual files on master eb6407355 + sase-18g landing diff fails the same set, including test_agent_prompt_semantic (3; CardPart isinstance), test_agent_prompt_panel_xprompts::test_update_display_renders_xprompts_after_detail_settles, test_agent_prompt_panel_steps::test_parallel_step_does_not_show_agent_prompt, and test_agent_jump_panel_visibility::test_search_overlay_keeps_jump_panel_visible (NoMatches #agent-prompt-scroll). Phases sase-18g.1 and sase-18g.3 had reproduced these on clean base trees before the xprompt detach landed (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes).

Independent clean-base reports from sase-17m.4.1 phase notes #1/#2/#5/#7/#8 observed the same completion snapshot and kind-coverage, keymap/help, prompt-panel, LLM-calls, and related test failures before the final agent-session sweep. Phase sase-17m.4.1.8 then fixed its own stale family/session expectations and reported 47,218 scoped passes with only the separate memory generator drift node; this corroborates the tracked clean-master test-failure cluster rather than a new rename blocker.

payload.entry: Supplementary evidence (sase-18d.7 land, 2026-09-25, master 02c4b029a): phase sase-18d.7.1 reported 34 clean-tree failures across tests/test_query_profile_agents.py, tests/completion, tests/ace/tui/test_kill_and_edit_prompt_name.py, tests/test_directives_bead.py. Rerunning exactly that set with .venv/bin/python after installing sase-core-rs 0.34.73 (the workspace had 0.34.71, and 'uv run' re-syncs back to 0.34.71) gives 373 passed / 1 failed, including completion test_snapshot and test_kind_coverage passing. The one remaining failure is sase-14o. A stale binding is a likely cause for part of this bead's 26 undiagnosed nodes; check the installed sase-core-rs version before triaging each one.

evidence.note: Independent repro by sase-17d.land (proposed by sase-17d.11 PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1): at master 8fd6a054fd, sase tool run check 3a18109b85b6805eda8d0c4c5375bc31 (escalated full lane, 47302 passed / 8 failed) still fails tests/test_keymaps_defaults_modes.py::test_zoom_and_agents_fold_defaults_are_in_sync_with_help (expects 'Set family level 1-2'; help now says 'Set session level 1-2' since b79b9da246). The prompt-panel CardPart and llm-calls timezone nodes in this bead now pass (fixed by bf3aa6c8a3). Same-cause stale family->session expectations also fail: test_keymaps_app_bindings.py::test_h_binding_metadata_describes_navigation_and_contextual_collapse, test_copy_agent_name.py::test_copy_agent_reference_warns_for_agent_session_container, test_dynamic_agent_session_root_zero_suffix.py::test_plan_chain_session_is_unaffected (also recorded on active rename epic sase-17m.5.1.6).

Independent sase-1ao landing rerun on clean master e922c424e after rebuilding current sase-core-rs 0.34.73: serial focused pytest of phase sase-1ao.2 note #1 groups gave 94 passed/4 failed. The completion failures are exact nodes already named here: tests/completion/test_snapshot.py::{test_checked_in_snapshot_has_no_drift,test_current_structural_view_matches_checked_in_snapshot} and tests/completion/test_kind_coverage.py::test_every_value_slot_is_kinded_choiced_or_hinted. Current missing value slots are tool/receipt:tool_receipt_tool and tool/receipts:tool_receipts_days, introduced by unrelated receipt CLI work. Admin Center resume, bgcmd, proc-observer, procs-pane-store, config schema, models surface, and agent-session terminology groups in the same run all passed. The fourth failure is a separate stale getting-started docs assertion filed as sase-1as.
